name: Matrix Robotics MATRIX-3
description: The third-generation flagship of **Matrix Robotics** (Shanghai, China), launched on **10 January 2026**. It stands **1.7 m**, weighs **65 kg**, wears a biomimetic fabric skin with tactile sensors, and has **27 degrees of freedom per hand**. An Early Access Program is open and pilot deployments were stated for mid-2026; shipping hardware has not been verified.
sourcing: Compiled from robotindex research, as of October 2026. The $99,000 figure comes from a single report and conflicts with the manufacturer having published no pricing, so it is stated as disputed rather than as a price. Pilot deployments were stated for mid-2026; this page does not confirm that any have shipped. No official GitHub organization was found.

pricing.summary: The price is **disputed**. One report says **$99,000** starting; Matrix Robotics has **not published pricing**. Treat any figure as unconfirmed.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body:
MATRIX-3 is Matrix Robotics' third-generation humanoid, launched in January 2026. It is **1.7 m** and **65 kg**, covered in a biomimetic fabric skin with tactile sensors, with **27 degrees of freedom in each hand** and a model called **WAVE**. The company has an **Early Access Program** open and stated pilot deployments for mid-2026.

Founder **Zhang Haixing** previously led Tesla China's Design and Research Centre and worked on early Optimus R&D, which is why the robot is often compared with [Tesla Optimus](/product-tesla-optimus). Pilot and early-access status is not shipping hardware, so the page stays under review. No official GitHub organization was found for Matrix Robotics; the humanoids table shows an em dash for "no account found", not a confirmed zero.
